functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.agentnexos_demo_ready()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_class where oid = 'public.agentnexos_demo_requests'::regclass);
$function$
